analysis:
Examined both supplied batch analyses against the canonical index and full T-041 definition. Both describe additions to provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/KVCacheSSD/SSDPrefixCacheTests.swift beginning at HEAD 3140: ownership revalidation after header corruption with restored mtime, and replacement of a malformed lookalike with an owned block. Those reported assertions support defensive testing, not a demonstrated runtime regression. The analyses also describe existing coverage for authenticated reads, bounded staging/donations, scope-separated HMAC tags, TTL/budget cleanup and symlink rejection; existing behavior must not be reported as newly introduced exposure.
Independent source verification is unavailable: integration_source omits all four reviewed source units, and neither the complete additions nor the associated SSDWholeRootMaintainer implementation is supplied. Thus no finding has an independently verified changed source line. This is a coverage limit, not clearance of the PR.
Remaining material review concerns T-041, TB-007, TB-003 and A-001: verify whether any production ownership-verdict memoization invalidates on replacement or mutation, safely handles enumeration/read/unlink races, and preserves no-follow traversal, accessible-volume TTL/budget cleanup and storage validation. Ownership recognition must not substitute for payload authentication. The two analyses raise the same unresolved contract and cannot resolve it with tests alone. No supplied evidence establishes changes to serving authorization, attestation, transport encryption, credentials, privileged helpers or billing.
